intro: Techbot's Memory Core is the polarized central repository of Tinkmaster Overspark's mechanical assistant, Techbot. Recovered from the malfunctioning automaton within the corrupted depths of Gnomeregan, it contains the critical data Overspark hopes to use to reverse the machine's reversed, negatronic behavior.

p: Before the catastrophe that forced the gnomes into exile, Techbot served Tinkmaster Overspark and his fellow inventors as an indispensable assistant, packed with gizmos and encyclopedic data. When Gnomeregan fell, an errant electrical discharge jolted the automaton, inverting its positronic brain into a hostile negatronic state. Driven mad by the reversal, Techbot now wanders the tainted halls of the city attacking anyone in sight. Recovering its memory core is Overspark's only hope for analyzing the malfunction and restoring his prized creation to its senses.
